name: Julie Chavez
jobTitle: CEO/Owner of Discounted Roofing & Remodeling Co.
description:
Julie Chavez is the owner and CEO of Discounted Roofing & Remodeling, a Texas roofing business based in Itasca and serving homeowners across a broader Texas service area. Public business records identify her as the company’s owner, principal contact, and customer contact; the business lists a 1996 start date, with local operations noted from 2011.

Julie Chavez is a Texas-based roofing and exterior-services business owner with decades of experience serving residential property owners through Discounted Roofing & Remodeling, also known through the Discounted Roofing brand, with a BBB profile that states the business has an A+ rating.. As CEO and owner, she leads a company focused on practical roofing solutions, storm-damage response, roof replacement, repairs, metal roofing, and exterior improvement services for homeowners throughout Texas.

With a business history dating to 1996, Julie has built her work around helping homeowners protect one of their most important investments: their homes. Her approach centers on clear communication, honest recommendations, dependable craftsmanship, and value-conscious solutions tailored to a property’s condition, damage level, roofing material, and long-term needs. Whether a homeowner is navigating hail damage, persistent leaks, an aging roof, or a full replacement project, Julie’s business is positioned to help make the process easier to understand and manage.

Julie’s leadership reflects the realities of the Texas roofing market, where severe weather, hail, wind, prolonged heat, and heavy rain can create both immediate damage and long-term roofing concerns. Through Discounted Roofing, she helps customers begin with a professional assessment, understand available repair or replacement paths, and choose appropriate solutions for their home and budget. The company also promotes durable metal-roofing options and exterior painting services, giving customers additional ways to strengthen and improve their properties.

Public records also show Julie Chavez listed as the applicant and contractor for a residential reroofing permit in Frisco, Texas. That record documents her direct role in roofing-project administration and identifies Discounted Roofing as the contractor associated with the permit.

Based in Itasca, Texas, Julie has developed Discounted Roofing & Remodeling as a customer-facing, owner-led business. As the listed principal and customer contact, she represents the company’s commitment to personal accountability, responsive service, and straightforward guidance from the initial inspection through final project completion.

Julie Chavez is the CEO and owner of Discounted Roofing & Remodeling, a Texas-based roofing company dedicated to helping homeowners protect, restore, and improve their properties. With a business history dating back to 1996, Julie has built her company around honest service, quality craftsmanship, clear communication, and practical solutions for homeowners facing roof damage, aging materials, storm-related concerns, and exterior improvement needs.

As a hands-on business owner, Julie understands that a roof is more than a construction project—it is a critical layer of protection for a family’s home and investment. Her goal is to help customers feel informed and confident throughout the process, beginning with an inspection and straightforward evaluation, continuing through repair or replacement recommendations, and ending with a clean, professionally completed project.

Through Discounted Roofing, Julie and her team provide residential roof inspections, storm and hail-damage assessments, roof repairs, roof replacements, metal roofing, and exterior painting. Her company serves Texas homeowners who need reliable help after severe weather, want to address leaks or worn roofing materials, or are planning a long-term exterior upgrade.

Julie’s leadership is rooted in accountability and customer service. As the listed owner, CEO, principal contact, and customer contact for Discounted Roofing & Remodeling, she remains closely associated with the customer experience and the company’s commitment to delivering fair value, clear answers, and dependable results.

Julie Chavez is the CEO and owner of Discounted Roofing & Remodeling, a Texas-based residential roofing and exterior-services company. With a business history dating to 1996, she helps homeowners address roof repairs, replacements, storm and hail damage, metal roofing, and exterior painting needs through clear communication, practical recommendations, and quality workmanship.
